thread:
Marta: Need a tidy plan for the routing-v2 handover. Customers want per-tenant opt-outs, deterministic canary steps, and clear ops runbook. Can we agree on owners + safety leash thresholds?
Devon: Proposal: 'slice orchestration' flow: micro-canary (0.2% single-tenant) -> cohort slices (1% multiple tenants) -> regional ramp (10%) -> global. Each step has a short infra window (10m) + quality window (90m).
Ibrahim: Infra notes: create a canary shepherd pool (pinned instances) and pre-warm cache/shards. Also isolate a fallback lane so traffic doesn't cascade back into overloaded instances.
Ruth: For experiments: keep a 5% session-sticky holdback per region as control. Shadow responses for 24h for non-sampled signals. We'll run golden-prompt validation after each ramp (n=100) and surface any new hallucination patterns.
Marta: Safety leash (short gates): immediate abort if 5xx delta > 0.45% absolute OR p95 latency increases > 30% vs baseline in the 10m window. Long gates (quality): require <1.0% drop on our eval correctness after 90m.
Devon: Fallback matrix: (A) model-variant fallback: v2 -> v2-eco for memory pressure, (B) shard-level degrade: route a subset back to v1 when shard queue depth > 40%, (C) tenant-level opt-out via override flag. Throttle auto-fallbacks to max 12% traffic/min to avoid cascades.
Ibrahim: Runbook snippet for quick revert (ops-friendly):
```
# flip flag for tenant or region
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/v1/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"routing_v2_enable","scope":"tenant","id":"TENANT_ID","value":false}'
# verify routing propagation
curl https://routing.internal/health?tenant=TENANT_ID
```
Ruth: Metrics & gates: build a dashboard 'routing_v2_sentinel' with panels: global 5xx, p50/p95 latency, per-tenant error heatmap, cost_delta, golden-prompt pass-rate. Alert on anomalies and page #eng-oncall if enterprise-tier impact.
Marta: Communications: send a targeted advisory 48h before >5% exposure. For any "high-touch" tenant, require an SE call before we cross 1% exposure. Add an opt-out link and a short rollback KB.
Devon: CI smoke tests: synthesize a 8-12% 5xx spike for 60s and assert fallback triggers within 50s and flag toggle completes within 90s. Also add a regression sentinel job that runs golden prompts and fails the PR if new hallucination patterns exceed threshold.
Ibrahim: Ownership: Marta = PM owner & customer comms, Devon = rollout orchestration & CI, Ruth = metrics & experiment analysis, Ibrahim = infra & fallback automation.
ops-bot: scheduler: routing-service:v2 canary scheduled -> start 2026-11-15T16:00Z (micro-canary). Watch: #eng-oncall.
Ruth: One more: we should capture 'fallback.reason' metric with labels {region,tenant,reason} and emit samples for every fallback event so we can triage root causes quickly.
Marta: OK owners set. Can everyone thumbs by EOD? I'll produce the release checklist + a short Loom of rollback steps for CS once we lock schedule. :white_check_mark:
